content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry), which the payer letter attributes to precertification not being obtained before the service was rendered. The clinical indication documents a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management, supporting the medical necessity of CPT 93229. We request reprocessing of the $738.30 outstanding balance on this episode (ep-05001) based on the documented indication."}
